newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Swire to sell Island Pl flats by ballot.
newsitem.headline: Swire to sell Island Pl flats by ballot.

text.p: Swire Pacific Ltd's Swire Properties Ltd said on Thursday it would sell by ballot 48 residential units in the fourth phase of sales of its Island Place development in North Point on Hong Kong Island.
The company spokeswoman said it will adopt a "drop-box" method for application forms to be handed in on January 22 to 23 instead of asking potential buyers to queue up to register.

The spokeswoman said 85 percent of units would be sold to potential buyers registered under their own names and 15 percent to buyers registered under company names, in a move to curb recent speculation in the property market, she said.
The fourth phase of sales includes 48 units comprising a selection of flats from all three residential towers, the company said in the statement.
The units range in size from 672 to 996 square feet. Details of the sale and ballot applications forms will be available on January 20.
In October, Swire offered the flats in its third phase of sales at an average price of HK$6,438 per square foot.
